newsitem.title: ECUADOR: Ecuador plans 3 austerity measures - gov't source.
newsitem.headline: Ecuador plans 3 austerity measures - gov't source.

text.p: Ecuador will announce three key measures to cut its budget deficit this week, a government source said Wednesday.

"There are three measures the executive has to deal with the fiscal deficit, but there is a series of additional alternatives that are being studied and will be announced at the proper moment," a government official, who asked not to be named, told Reuters.

One of the measures is collecting a $60 million debt from electricity firm Emelec. The government would also raise $40 million through changes in taxation on fuel distributors, and $60 million by reducing electricity subsidies.

The government of President Fabian Alarcon inherited a budget deficit of 6.6-6.9 percent of gross domestic product when it took over power from former President Abdala Bucaram in February. Congress expelled Bucaram from office just six months after taking power on grounds of "mental incompetence."

The budget deficit is now at 4.6 percent of GDP, after a 10 percent reduction in public spending and improved tax collection, but the government hopes to squeeze the fiscal gap to 2.5-2.7 percent of GDP by the end of the year.
